mapper.select:
/* 내 지출 목록(최신순·금액순) */ SELECT FROM EXPND E LEFT JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = E.PET_SN WHERE E.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND E.DEL_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY
E.EXPND_AMT DESC, E.EXPND_YMD DESC, E.EXPND_SN DESC
E.EXPND_YMD DESC, E.EXPND_SN DESC

/* 내 지출이 남은 반려동물(삭제된 반려동물 포함, 공용 제외) */ SELECT P.PET_SN , P.PET_NM , CASE WHEN P.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS PET_DEL_YN FROM PET P WHERE P.PET_SN IN (SELECT E.PET_SN FROM EXPND E WHERE E.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.PET_SN IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY P.PET_SN

/* 기간 내 날짜별 합계·건수(1건인 날만 반려동물·카테고리) */ SELECT E.EXPND_YMD , SUM(E.EXPND_AMT) AS TOTAL_EXPND_AMT , COUNT(*) AS EXPND_CNT , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(E.PET_SN) END AS PET_SN , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(P.PET_NM) END AS PET_NM , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 AND MIN(E.PET_SN) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(CASE WHEN P.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 END AS PET_DEL_YN , CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(E.EXPND_CLSF_CD) END AS EXPND_CLSF_CD FROM EXPND E LEFT JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = E.PET_SN WHERE E.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.EXPND_YMD BETWEEN #{startYmd} AND #{endYmd} GROUP BY E.EXPND_YMD ORDER BY E.EXPND_YMD

/* 기간 내 반려동물별 합계(등록순, 공용 제외, 삭제된 반려동물 포함) */ SELECT E.PET_SN , MIN(P.PET_NM) AS PET_NM , MAX(CASE WHEN P.DEL_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS PET_DEL_YN , SUM(E.EXPND_AMT) AS TOTAL_EXPND_AMT FROM EXPND E JOIN PET P ON P.PET_SN = E.PET_SN WHERE E.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND E.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.EXPND_YMD BETWEEN #{startYmd} AND #{endYmd} GROUP BY E.PET_SN ORDER BY E.PET_SN

/* 내 지출 한 건 */ SELECT EXPND_SN , PET_SN , MBR_SN , RECPT_SN , EXPND_CLSF_CD , EXPND_INPT_MTH_CD , EXPND_AMT , EXPND_PLCUS_NM , DTL_MTTR , EXPND_YMD , IDMPT_DMND_ID , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM EXPND WHERE EXPND_SN = #{expndSn} AND MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
